decisions.reason: Although it is technically close to the firm's underground transport know-how, the earlier withdrawal of the loader line and the product's later absence from observed pages suggest that learning from launch has not translated into a robust enough business to justify continued resource commitment.

This construction site dumper builds directly on the firm's related knowledge in specialized construction transport equipment and service, so management can plausibly absorb early market feedback and improve it commercially.

The inclined furniture lift is somewhat more adjacent to the core business, but it still relies on the firm's lifting, safety and maintenance capabilities, which gives enough absorptive capacity to continue refining the line.

The inclined building material lift fits very well with the firm's construction and lifting applications, customer base and service model, making it a strong candidate for continued development rather than withdrawal.

While the truck-mounted inclined furniture lift uses related vehicle and lift integration skills, its narrower niche and greater complexity make it a weaker use of the firm's learning and development resources than the broader lift and construction products.
